items.title: AI industry is just following Jensen Huang's lead, Salesforce CEO explains
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) CEO Marc Benioff speaks with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about how the AI industry is just following Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang's lead and the chipmaker's contribution to Salesforce's AIforce platform.

items.title: AI is the latest addiction — Does it need to be regulated like cigarettes?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) kicked off its Dreamforce 2026 conference this week, where the company unveiled its new AI-powered AIforce platform. Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff weighs in on how AI should be regulated, comparing the new technology to the addictive nature of cigarettes and social media on younger users.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg and Nvidia CEO weigh in on Anthropic AI proposal
items.summary: A proposal from one of AI’s most influential CEOs has sparked a response from two industry heavyweights.

items.title: The Palantir Question Nobody Can Answer Yet: How Big Can This Get?
items.summary: Palantir is posting growth numbers that make every enterprise software peer look slow, yet the stock has gone nowhere for a year. Understanding why reveals something uncomfortable about what fair value actually means for a company this unusual.
